line_1.speaker: The Widow
line_1.text: Hierarch. Not a name, a post — that is the trick of it. Kill the man and the post is still open and the handwriting simply gets a little less steady.

line_2.speaker: The Widow
line_2.text: Because he goes up that stair between the last bell and the first, and in eleven years he did not once vary. I wanted to be certain, and then I wanted to be certain again.

line_3.speaker: The Widow
line_3.text: Us. All of us, totalled. He has kept the line clear at the bottom of the page for a very long time, and he has never once written in it early.

gated.speaker: The Widow
gated.text: You brought the lector up. Good. She has the struck line and I have the name and neither of us can do a thing with only one of them.

start.speaker: The Widow
start.text: The Widow of the Stair has taken a corner of the tower and made it look lived in, which is more than the tower has managed on its own.

choices.text: I want to go home from down there.

veil_service.speaker: The Widow
veil_service.text: Give me the dark off it and I will give you a bone that knows the way up. I have made a great many of these and used none.

veil_arc.speaker: The Widow
veil_arc.text: I will say them when there is somebody left to be owed. Until then they are mine, and I keep them the way the vault kept the measure, and I am aware of the comparison.
